column1: # Samsung's in-call route for: incall_nb-handset gain-incall_nb-handset incall_nb-handset-mic gain-incall_nb-handset-mic
# mixer_gains_r18.xml. The 156-control initial block is deliberately NOT
# included: droid-alsa-mixer.service already applied it at boot, and
# re-applying it mid-call would tear down the route being set up.
# Applied on call start by d2s-incall-audio.service; undone on call end
# by re-applying the boot lists. Order matters - do not sort.
# Android's audio mode. The vendor HAL calls setMode(AUDIO_MODE_IN_CALL)
# from code - NO mixer path in Samsung's tables sets it (it appears only
# once, as NORMAL, in the initial block). With that HAL unloadable here,
# nothing ever took the DSP out of media mode, so the in-call routes were
# correct but silent. Restoring is automatic: the boot media list re-applies
# the initial block, which sets NORMAL again.
